news.headline: Vikings activate RB Jordan Mason off injured reserve
news.description: The Vikings activated running back Jordan Mason from injured reserve Saturday, completing his recovery from a fractured thumb that required surgery last month.

news.headline: 49ers WR Evans, DE Bosa, WR Samuel out vs. Atlanta; WR Kirk may return
news.description: 49ers receivers Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr., and defensive end Nick Bosa are among a half dozen players who have been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

news.headline: Eagles' DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks out vs. Cowboys
news.description: The Eagles' top two receivers -- DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks -- have been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Cowboys.

news.headline: Packers activate RB Josh Jacobs for 2026 debut
news.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs will make his 2026 season debut against the Lions after spending the first six weeks on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.

news.headline: Seahawks rule out RB Zach Charbonnet vs. Chiefs
news.description: RB Zach Charbonnet's season debut will have to wait at least one more week as the Seahawks have ruled him out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

news.headline: Browns RBs Quinshon Judkins, Dylan Sampson expected to play
news.description: The Browns' top two running backs, Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson, are expected to play against the Titans after being sidelined with injuries.

news.headline: Sources: Colts face big decisions on star players as NFL trade deadline looms
news.description: The Colts are expected to field trade inquiries on some of their star players, including Jonathan Taylor, DeForest Buckner and Quenton Nelson.

news.headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
news.description: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.

news.headline: Why Derrick Henry has taken Jets RB Braelon Allen under his wing
news.description: After Henry saw Allen wearing his shirt in college, he reached out to him, and the two running backs have kept in touch since.

news.headline: Sources: Josh Simmons told to leave Chiefs meeting by Andy Reid, Patrick Mahomes
news.description: Josh Simmons was kicked out of a team meeting by Chiefs coach Andy Reid and QB Patrick Mahomes, but the OT later apologized, sources told NFL Network.
